name: MOCHI e

specs.notes: Honda's retro city EV: a 113 kW (154 PS), 315 N m motor driving the rear wheels through one gear, a 35.5 kWh battery under the floor, about 50:50 weight; 1,527 kg; 0-100 km/h in 8.3 s, 145 km/h limited; 2,530 mm wheelbase, 3,894 x 1,752 x 1,512 mm (evspecifications.com, cars-data.com). The motor's top speed and the reduction ratio are estimates (the gearing is set from the 145 km/h limit).

garage.blurb: A tiny electric hatch with cameras for mirrors and screens across the dash: silent, instant torque to the rear wheels, and done at 145 km/h. Hilarious on a touge.

interior.notes: The model's detailed cabin: the wheel cut out by part (its rim, centre, buttons and paddles; the stalks and column stay), the seat found by the probe; left-hand drive. Single-speed: the hands stay on the wheel.

limitations: The motor's top speed and the reduction ratio are estimates.
Its seat stitching (100k triangles), the rear defroster lines, a ground shadow plane and the author's name plate dropped; the wheel-centre badges dropped (they'd not have turned with the wheels).
Honda badges stay on the body (texture-free logo meshes).
